science_guardrails: Illustrative nest geometry and insect scale; no measured depths or temperature thresholds.
Workers use the kit's six thoracic legs, two waist nodes and elbowed antennae. Larvae are pale and legless; pupae are exposed developing ants.
Irregular soil dome has no central opening. Rain and wind convey cold, wet weather without snow or an invented physiological response.
Water occupies spaces between soil aggregates below the brood; no drowning, guaranteed survival, treatments or desiccation mechanism.
Only the supplied kit captions appear as words. No icons, arrows or other explanatory symbols.
All beat times are absolute word starts. During speech pauses, the preceding action continues with camera travel, larval wriggles, walking and weather.

shots.visual: A large curved larva wriggles in an earthen nursery beside an exposed pale ant pupa. Eggs sit on the lower shelf.

beats.action: Move closer to the pale larva already wriggling in frame.
The larva curls; the camera widens toward the adjacent pupa.
Expose the pupa's folded legs, waist and darker developing eye.

shots.camera: Close lateral drift with a continuous pullback.

shots.visual: A worker tends the same young in a wider nursery. Its antennae reach toward the brood above the floor.

beats.action: Cut wider to reveal a nurse walking beneath the brood shelf.
The worker lifts its antennae toward the pale young.
The nurse tips its head toward the larva as the camera reveals the enclosing soil.

shots.camera: Track the nurse with a steady inward push.
shots.transition_in: Hard cut to a wider view of the same nursery.

shots.visual: The nursery becomes one occupied chamber inside a soil-dome cutaway, surrounded by soil and surface weather.

beats.action: Cut out to reveal the mound and connected underground rooms.
Cloud shadow spreads across the mound while the camera travels down toward its occupied chamber.

shots.camera: Push down through the cutaway toward the nursery.
shots.transition_in: Hard cut from the brood to its nest context.

shots.visual: A large worker carries a pale larva inside the nursery, making the connection between the nest and its young concrete.

beats.action: Match cut onto the larva in a nurse's mandibles; follow the carrying worker across the chamber through the speech pause.

shots.camera: Continuous close tracking move; soil shelves pass behind the worker.
shots.transition_in: Match cut to a worker carrying the young.

shots.visual: Cool grey clouds sweep above the same soil mound; the grass bends under a sustained gust.

beats.action: Cut outside to moving clouds and the mound.
A darker cloud layer crosses the sky and the grass bends further in the gust.

shots.camera: Push toward the dome while drifting against the wind.
shots.transition_in: Hard cut outside on the new sentence.

shots.visual: Rain falls onto the mound and spreads into small puddles beside it.

beats.action: Cut closer as thick paper raindrops fall and puddles spread beside the mound.
Rain strikes the ground in alternating splashes; wind continues to bend the grass.

shots.camera: Close sideways drift across the rain and mound.
shots.transition_in: Hard cut to a lower, closer weather view.

shots.visual: Several workers move through two separated nursery corridors, establishing the colony as a group.

beats.action: Reveal six spaced workers walking through two levels of earthen galleries.
Track the group toward the rising passage at the right.

shots.camera: Continuous rightward tracking move through the galleries.

shots.visual: A worker carrying a larva climbs an inclined earthen passage toward the upper nest.

beats.action: Cut close to a worker already stepping up the incline with a larva.
Track upward with the carrier, uncovering the higher end of the passage.

shots.camera: Track up and right along the sloping passage.

shots.visual: The upper mound cutaway contains several occupied rooms, with more than one worker and brood location.

beats.action: Reveal the upper rooms with larvae and workers on separate floors.
Slide across to the adjacent occupied room.
Pull back enough to include the mound's intact soil roof and grass at its sides.

shots.camera: Lateral drift followed by an uninterrupted widening move.
shots.transition_in: Hard cut from the climbing worker to the upper mound.

shots.words: where they can take advantage of
shots.visual: Workers remain in the upper rooms while clouds start moving aside above the soil roof.

beats.action: Cut wider to connect the occupied upper rooms to the sky above them.
Clouds slide apart, opening a patch of pale sky directly over the mound.
The last cloud edge moves off the upper roof, leaving the occupied rooms in view.

shots.camera: Push upward from the upper rooms toward the clearing sky.
shots.transition_in: Hard cut to a wider surface-and-nest view.

shots.visual: A large paper sun and its rotating rays appear over the upper mound. A broad translucent paper light patch reaches the soil surface.

beats.action: Reveal the sun and moving rays; sunlight lands on the upper soil while the workers remain beneath it.
Track from the bright roof back toward the occupied upper room.

shots.camera: Short diagonal push from sun toward the mound.
shots.transition_in: Hard cut to the sunlit mound.

shots.visual: A nurse carries a large, clearly visible larva across an upper nursery floor.

beats.action: Cut to the worker holding the larva securely in its mandibles.
Push closer to the curved pale larva while the worker steps forward.

shots.camera: Close tracking push onto the carried larva.
shots.transition_in: Match cut from occupied chamber to its carrier.

shots.visual: A wider cutaway puts the brood in an upper chamber, with a visible band of soil separating it from blue wet pores below.

beats.action: Pull out to reveal the brood high above the saturated lower soil.
Continue down far enough to show the uninterrupted soil gap between brood and wet ground.

shots.camera: Widen and tilt down while retaining the upper nursery.
shots.transition_in: Hard cut wider to reveal vertical separation.

shots.visual: Close-up of irregular soil aggregates with blue water occupying the gaps between them. Solid soil remains visible throughout.

beats.action: Cut close to the lower soil; paper water spreads between the brown aggregates and small highlights travel through the wet pores.

shots.camera: Continuous diagonal macro drift through the wet soil.
shots.transition_in: Hard cut to the saturated-soil detail.

shots.visual: The closing cutaway reunites the damp lower soil, separating earth, and occupied upper nursery under the mound. This leaves the nest ready for the following hot-weather contrast.

beats.action: Cut back to the whole relationship: wet soil below, brood above; keep the camera drawing back through the closing pause.

shots.camera: Continuous pullback with slight lateral drift.
shots.transition_in: Hard cut back to the complete cutaway.
